results: Actual next-action handler does not revalidate actor at admission/settlement; synthetic revocation after context resolution still returns result and settles mocked quota. Actual quota authority helper requires separate verification.
Two identical requests invoke mocked provider twice and complete two allowance records; no durable operation/recovery protocol, so response loss can lead to paid repeat generation.
scope: Actual next-action handler with synthetic Prisma/context/quota/provider. No real provider, production, PostgreSQL schedule or authenticated browser.
